Remark
[isotropic implies homogeneous]

Source: petersen:page-0239 ↗ def:pet-ch5-fixed-point-set 1. ch5:5.9.14A manifold is isotropic at $p$ if $\operatorname {Iso}_p$ acts transitively on the unit sphere in $T_pM$. Show isotropy at every point implies homogeneity.
